source_caption_text:
Me after being left on seen for longer than a min 😂

In May 2016, Drake hosted Saturday Night Live and served as the musical guest, delivering one of the night’s funniest moments with the digital short “Drake’s Beef.” The sketch played on Drake’s reputation for taking things personally by turning harmless interactions backstage into dramatic rap feuds.

Throughout the sketch, Drake stays completely polite in person while imagining elaborate diss tracks over the smallest inconveniences. He gets offended by jokes, people not saying hello, and even someone being “rude to my hat,” turning everyday situations into hilariously serious beef.

The pettiness reaches another level when Drake goes after a janitor for throwing away a water bottle that still had a few sips left, before even taking issue with Lorne Michaels for simply telling him “good job.” The sketch remains one of Drake’s funniest SNL appearances and a perfect parody of his larger-than-life rap persona.
